newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Sona Topas sees 1997 net almost double.
newsitem.headline: Sona Topas sees 1997 net almost double.

text.p: Indonesian PT Sona Topas Tourism Industry said on Friday it expected its net profit to almost double to 25 billion rupiah in 1997 following the opening of its large duty free shop in resort island of Bali.
"We expect our net profit to almost double to 25 billion rupiah this year after the opening of our duty free outlet in Bali," president director Djoni Lasmana told Reuters.
Sona, Indonesia's largest duty free operator, posted a net profit of 13.6 billion rupiah in 1996.
Lasmana said its new Bali outlet opened in late March had boosted the firm's selling space by 8,000 square metres to some 12,000 square metres.
